subject: dxf: add api to manually tune the calculation of resource related params (#63517)
summary: Adds a per-keyspace DXF schedule “tune factors” (currently `amplify_factor`) persisted in meta and managed via a new status HTTP endpoint; nextgen DDL add-index/add-PK resource parameter calculation (concurrency/max nodes) now routes through a `ResourceCalc` that incorporates these factors, defaulting safely when unset/expired.
